reason: Correction to attempts:1541: its claim that all 36 transactions were in the cbBTC/USDC market is false. The script counted distinct markets per transaction, not across transactions. A separate ledger GROUP BY market finds eight markets: cbBTC/USDC 0x9103c3b4... is 372/404 liquidations in 25/36 transactions; seven other markets account for 32 liquidations in 11 transactions. The gas and payout numbers in attempts:1541 remain correct. Among the 11 non-cbBTC transactions, 9 cost >$1 gas at the $1,800/ETH reference. The two below $1 are cbETH/USDC market 0x0ca10126... at block 55636071 (4 liquidations, $1.517 USDC payout, $0.405 gas) and market 0x67ebd84b... at block 57501189 (1 liquidation, zero owner payout, $0.535 gas). Thus there is exactly one measured, non-overlapping paid batch that fits the cheap-chain trial send cap in seven days. It is a legitimate possible follow-up, though its observed gross pool is only $1.517/week and a second Base trial currently has a gate funding refusal. Do not treat the entire class as already covered by trial-morpho-cbbtc-base.
